content: Individualized medical nutrition therapy is a critical component in the management of type 1 diabetes. It focuses on the precise regulation of carbohydrate intake and glycemic control, achieved through experience-based estimation techniques. Patients should receive education on the composition of foods and the appropriate dosing of insulin, which includes understanding meal structure and its impact on blood glucose levels. Regular nutritional assessments conducted by a registered dietitian are strongly recommended to ensure optimal management and adjustment of dietary strategies.
